Recorded claim:
Thunderbird already has Marionette coverage and Taskcluster wiring for startup/restart, session restore, compose, command-line, toolbar migration, and system integration at `mail/test/marionette/manifest.toml` and `taskcluster/kinds/test/marionette.yml`. WebdriverIO’s likely unique benefit is authoring/selector discovery, not unavailable coverage. [Task 1]
